name: Revolution of the Earth
core_idea: While rotating on its own axis, the Earth also revolves around the Sun as we learnt in Grade 6.
supporting_evidence: Revolution is the motion of an object around another object.

supporting_evidence: We know that this occurs due to the Earth’s rotation.

name: Seasons on the Earth
core_idea: I have noticed that we go through a cycle of seasons every year.
supporting_evidence: Is it related to the revolution of the Earth around the Sun in some way? I have also noticed that days are longer in summer than in winter.
The Earth’s axis of rotation is not upright with respect to the orbit, but is tilted.

name: Solar eclipse
core_idea: At certain times, the Moon can come in between the Sun and the Earth in a way that obstructs the light from the Sun from reaching us.
supporting_evidence: You may wonder how the Moon, which is smaller than the Sun, blocks the light coming from the Sun that we see in the sky.

name: Lunar eclipse
core_idea: As the Moon revolves around the Earth, sometimes the Earth can block the sunlight from reaching the Moon.
supporting_evidence: On such days, we see the Earth’s shadow falling on the full disc of the Moon.
